{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure we only keep one row per patient, with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify: should now have 800 rows
print(f'Number of rows after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Check the arm distribution in the deduplicated data
print('\nArm distribution after deduplication:')
print(df_dedup['arm'].value_counts())

# Compute response rate for each arm
response_rate_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_control = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute the treatment effect (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

# Print the results
print(f'\nResponse rate, treatment arm: {response_rate_treatment:.4f}')
print(f'Response rate, control arm: {response_rate_control:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect:.4f}')"}
